dimensions.evidenceA: Saul inquires and receives no answer.
dimensions.evidenceB: Saul does not inquire of the LORD.
dimensions.label: Inquiry statement

evidence.observation: Saul inquires of the LORD, but the LORD does not answer by dreams, Urim, or prophets.
Chronicles says Saul asked counsel of a medium and did not inquire of the LORD.

record.tension: Samuel and Chronicles make differing statements about whether Saul inquired of the LORD before seeking the medium.
record.title: Does Saul inquire of the LORD?
